description: Same as postmd_create_document, but reads the Markdown from filePath on the machine running this MCP server — use it for large files instead of pasting the body. Without an API key it returns data.controlToken and data.retainedUntil, same as above.

fileName.description: Upload filename. Defaults to the basename of filePath.

filePath.description: Path to a .md file on the MCP server host, read as UTF-8. Prefer an absolute path.

groupId.description: File the document in this group instead of the default group (needs an API key).

password.description: Readers must supply this password to see the content.

shareEndDate.description: yyyyMMdd. The document stops being served after this date. Omit for no end date.

title.description: Defaults to the file name without .md.

viewerStyle.description: Viewer theme: readable (default), github, minimal, report, pamphlet or dark. Unknown values fall back to readable.

name: postmd_create_document_from_file
